artifact_serialization.allowed_values: object, list, string, integer, boolean, null
artifact_serialization.floats: forbidden; non-JSON runtime values and float fault cases use typed descriptors
artifact_serialization.digest_ownership: this artifact embeds neither its own digest nor a future contract-bundle digest; an external exact artifact set owns both bindings

input_authority.firewall_accepted: production authority supplied only after the allow-list public firewall accepted the projection
input_authority.conformance_fixture: offline test authority; forbidden as a production substitute for firewall acceptance
input_authority.private_hashes: raw_private_hash, token_free_callback_hash, callback_binding_hash, Search tokens, and private object identities are forbidden from builder input, window payload, fingerprints, policy input, and public output
input_authority.chooser_player_index: exact JSON/runtime integer 0 or 1; booleans and implicit numeric coercions are rejected

decision_states.policy_allowed: a window exists, structural/cardinality checks passed, all interpreted enums are official-known, and policy output may be validated
decision_states.fallback_only: a window exists and deterministic fallback is legal, but at least one current selection enum has unknown semantics; policy output is ignored
decision_states.reject: no window exists and no index output may be fabricated because public authority, structure, types, additive-key isolation, or cardinality is invalid

exact_runtime_types.integer: exact runtime integer; bool, float, numeric string, and implicit coercions are rejected. Language-specific integer subtypes are tested by that binding and are not encoded as shared JSON values
exact_runtime_types.list: Python type(value) is list and Godot typeof(value) is TYPE_ARRAY; tuple and other iterables are rejected
exact_runtime_types.object: exact JSON object/Dictionary with exact JSON string keys
exact_runtime_types.hash_string: exact runtime string matching uppercase SHA-256; StringName and implicit conversion are rejected

select_contract.deck: null or exact ordered list of public Card objects authorized by this selection
select_contract.contextCard: null or exact public Card object
select_contract.effect: null or exact public Card object
select_contract.cardinality: require exact integers and 0 <= minCount <= maxCount <= len(option); any violation is reject
select_contract.immutability: deep-copy caller input; getters and serialized views must not expose mutable aliases
select_contract.unknown_additive_public_key: reject at select, Option, Card, and every nested public object boundary; do not copy the unknown key or value into the window, any hash input, or diagnostics
select_contract.unknown_additive_diagnostic: emit only the stable parent JSON pointer and reason code unknown_public_key; never echo the unknown child key name or value

option_contract.known_type_rule: compare the exact present key set with that raw OptionType's locked sparse shape; exact match is policy-eligible, while missing expected keys, explicit null, or additional already-known official-universe keys preserve the raw option and force fallback_only
option_contract.unknown_type_rule: retain only already-known official field names and mark fallback_only; any new field name is an additive public key and rejects the build
option_contract.field_presence: retain every present official field including explicit null; do not synthesize absent fields
option_contract.field_values: all present non-type official fields are exact safe integers or null; a present non-null cardId is additionally required to be positive
option_contract.known_sparse_fields_other_than_type: absence remains part of the raw authority and is never filled with null; any key-set drift from the locked official writer shape forces fallback_only but retains enough option-count authority for deterministic legal indexes
option_contract.unknown_enum_semantics: preserve the raw integer and mark fallback_only; do not map it to an existing name
option_contract.locked_engine_only_enum_semantics: preserve the raw integer and mark fallback_only because it is not official SDK-known selection semantics
option_contract.reorder_rule: any option reorder creates a distinct window ID and requires fresh indexes/fingerprints

hash_contract.canonical_json: RFC 8785 JCS using the bounded I-JSON rules and exact runtime string requirements from cabt_tree_hash_v1
hash_contract.digest: SHA-256 over prefix bytes followed immediately by canonical JSON bytes; output uppercase hexadecimal

payload.select: exact validated raw SelectData tree with official option order and missing/null distinction

payload.option: exact raw sparse Option object, including every present null and excluding every missing field
payload.context_card: exact raw public Card object or null
payload.effect: exact raw public Card object or null

fingerprint_contract.order: fingerprint array order equals official option order
fingerprint_contract.identity: option position and exact cardId/serial values remain distinct even if display semantics appear equal
fingerprint_contract.purpose: window-scoped audit and binding identity only; policy still returns the official index

sanitizer_contract.input: a policy proposal against one policy_allowed immutable window
sanitizer_contract.order: preserve accepted policy order exactly; never sort or deduplicate
sanitizer_contract.atomic_failure: on any invalid element or property discard the entire proposal; do not retain a legal prefix or subset
sanitizer_contract.fallback_only_window: policy is not called or its result is ignored; resolve through deterministic fallback
sanitizer_contract.reject_window: cannot be sanitized because no window exists

fallback_contract.input_authority: the same immutable current public window only
fallback_contract.forbidden_inputs: hidden state, raw GameState, private replay, private callback hash, legacy strategy, stale indexes, prior scores, RNG, network, external compute

branch_order.indexes: all indexes 0 through option_count-1 in official order
first min_count indexes in official order

fallback_contract.invalid_policy_output: discard the whole proposal and execute the branch result
fallback_contract.fault_outcome: exception, timeout, and unavailable execute the branch result
fallback_contract.postcondition: the result is a fresh legal list[int] for this exact window

result_serialization_contract.scope: SelectionIssue, WindowBuildResult, SelectionValidation, SelectionResolution, PinnedDeckBuildResult, and InitialDeckResolution public dictionaries are audit and cross-runtime conformance DTOs only.
result_serialization_contract.not_authority: A serialized dictionary, a JSON Schema pass, or a caller-constructed result object never authorizes an action, window, pinned deck, or engine execution.
result_serialization_contract.owner_provenance: Factory seals, owner registries, sealed public snapshots, and context validation detect ordinary construction mistakes, stale bindings, and mutation; they are implementation-integrity checks, not a cryptographic or hostile in-process reflection boundary.
result_serialization_contract.consumer_rule: No execution layer may accept a caller-supplied result DTO as authority, even when its integrity validator returns true. A trusted owner call must receive the exact current CabtSelectionWindow or verified pinned authority plus the raw proposal or fault, compute the result in that same call path, and any later engine executor must independently validate its own current-window ticket.
result_serialization_contract.mutation_rule: Mutation that diverges from the sealed public snapshot fails integrity; copying fields, a seal, a snapshot, JSON, or a schema-valid dictionary never grants authority, and consumer-context revalidation prevents indexes or Card IDs outside the supplied current authority.
result_serialization_contract.candidate_reason_code: A closed diagnostic that explains candidate acceptance or fallback only; it is not deck authority and cannot replace pinned authority validation.
result_serialization_contract.schema_limit: JSON Schema closes representable shapes, codes, and branch relationships but cannot prove index bounds against a separate current window or exact Card IDs against a separate pinned authority.

initial_deck_contract.separate_domain: deck Card IDs are never validated as regular option indexes
initial_deck_contract.candidate: when returned, it must be an exact list of exactly 60 exact positive integers matching pinned_card_ids
initial_deck_contract.pinned_card_ids: independently validate the exact same shape before comparison
initial_deck_contract.comparison: candidate must equal pinned_card_ids element-for-element and in order
initial_deck_contract.duplicates: allowed because physical deck counts repeat official Card IDs
initial_deck_contract.candidate_failure: candidate length/type/value/mismatch, exception, timeout, or unavailable discards the candidate and returns the already verified pinned 60-card list
initial_deck_contract.pinned_authority_failure: invalid pinned shape/value/hash rejects explicitly because no independently verified fixed deck exists; never synthesize or guess a deck

successful_resolution.returned_valid_candidate: return the exact candidate list with owner initial_candidate and reason pinned_deck_accepted
successful_resolution.candidate_or_policy_fault: return a fresh copy of pinned_card_ids with owner pinned_deck_fallback, reason pinned_deck_fallback, and fallback_branch pinned_verified_deck
successful_resolution.invalid_pinned_authority: return no deck, owner none, reason invalid_pinned_deck, and explicit reject

initial_deck_contract.only_accepted_p1_wp3_authority: the runtime must match artifact_id, source_sha256, scope, exact card_ids sequence, and deck_hash from this normative profile; conformance vectors test the profile but are never production runtime configuration. An arbitrary self-consistent 60-card list or caller-supplied source label is rejected
